_comment_excel: EXCEL MODE — reads the open Bloomberg workbook via xlwings.
_comment_positioning: POSITIONING — also stream the Sparta order-level workbook (kept open alongside the prices one). Reads it by name. Set enabled=false to turn off.
_comment_voloi: VOLUME & OI — also stream the Energy Volume/OI workbook (kept open alongside the others). Reads it by name. every_n_cycles: push once every N poll cycles (3-min bars / daily OI change slowly). tail_bars: how many recent 3-min bars per contract to send.
_comment_blpapi: BLPAPI MODE — set mode=blpapi and map labels to securities.
